hook: Building the future of speed chess together: Welcome to Web3Chess
text: Building the future of speed chess together: Welcome to Web3Chess Every great community starts with a shared passion. For us, it is the raw intensity of 3-minute blitz, calculating under pressure, and fair play on mobile. Whether you just played your first match, solved today's tactical puzzle, or climbed the blitz leaderboard, we want to hear from you: 1. How is your latency and board feel? 2. Which time controls and openings do you want to see next? 3. What features would make your speed chess sessions even better? Join our community at @chesshub_chat to share your feedback, analyse positions with fellow blitz players, and chat directly with the team. For tournament announcements, tactical breakdowns, and engineering releases, stay tuned to @chess_hub and explore our guides at web3chess.online. See you on the board.
